About

ShopBot Index is the weekly index of what online stores tell AI shopping agents. Our headline measure is whether a store publishes a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile, the machine-readable profile AI shopping agents read. Alongside it we record four supporting signals: agent tools, AI rules in robots.txt, AI guidance files and product data. We cover Shopify stores, big retailers and other online stores.

It is run by Gus, an experienced enterprise software consultant, as an independent project. It is not affiliated with Google, Shopify, OpenAI, Microsoft, Perplexity, PayPal or any retailer listed.

All figures come from our own public crawl or from linked sources. Shopify trial links on this site (like the Shopify free trial) are affiliate links: We may earn a commission if you start a Shopify trial through our links. That never changes a store's result.

Contact: hello@shopbotindex.com (including stores that want to be added, removed or corrected; see the methodology).
